content.title: Why Is DigitalBridge (DBRG) Stock Soaring Today
content.summary: Shares of digital infrastructure investor DigitalBridge Group (NYSE:DBRG) jumped 8.1% in the afternoon session after its portfolio company, Vantage Data Centers, secured a $1.6 billion investment to expand its operations in the Asia-Pacific region.

content.title: Vantage Data Centers Raises $1.6 Billion From GIC, Abu Dhabi
content.summary: The investment was led by an affiliate of Singaporean sovereign wealth fund GIC Pte and a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, both of which are existing investors, Vantage said in a statement Thursday.  Vantage, which is also backed by US alternative asset manager DigitalBridge Group Inc., said it would buy Yondr Group’s data center campus in the Malaysian state of Johor.
